data.title: Infrastructure
data.tagline: Critical assets designed for the handover, not only the opening.
data.overview: Infrastructure projects are judged decades after commissioning. We focus on interface management, commissioning evidence, and the operating model that keeps an asset useful long after the project team has left.

challenges.title: Interface complexity
challenges.description: Many packages, one operating outcome, and unclear accountability at the seams.

challenges.title: Long asset life
challenges.description: Design decisions lock in maintenance cost for decades.

challenges.title: Handover gaps
challenges.description: Documentation and training arrive too late to shape safe operation.

image.alt: Container cranes above stacked shipping containers

solutions.title: Industrial Automation
solutions.tagline: Control architecture, robotics, and line integration engineered for uptime.
solutions.overview: Meridian designs and commissions automation systems that connect machines, safety, and production data into one dependable operating layer. We work backwards from the process: cycle time, quality, and maintainability come before hardware selection.

image.alt: Industrial robotic arm on an engineering bench

solutions.title: Infrastructure Engineering
solutions.tagline: Resilient electrical, utility, and facility systems for critical operations.
solutions.overview: From load studies to commissioning, we engineer the physical systems that keep production and services running. Our work is judged by resilience, maintainability, and a handover package the client's own team can operate.

image.alt: Container cranes above stacked shipping containers

solutions.title: System Integration
solutions.tagline: One accountable team across vendors, protocols, and sites.
solutions.overview: We take responsibility for the seams. Meridian coordinates vendors, designs the integration layer, tests the whole system, and stays accountable when something does not behave as specified.

related_projects.title: A water network that finds its own losses
related_projects.summary: A regional water utility connected pump stations and district meters to cut restoration time and technical losses.
